data.name: Arib
data.gender_notes: Arib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'arabah' which means 'mountain'. It implies strength, nobility, and courage, as mountains are symbolic of these traits in Islamic tradition. The name Arib carries the meaning “Noble, Mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arib usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arib is a name with deep spiritual significance, representing the noble and generous qualities of the soul. It is a name that inspires respect, admiration, and love, and is a reminder of the potential for greatness within each of us.
data.etymology: Arib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arib total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Arib
in_english.meaning: Arib is a name meaning high, superior or excellent
in_english.long_meaning: Arib is a name derived from the Arabic root 'arab' meaning high, superior or excellent. In Islamic tradition, this name refers to a person who is high in their actions. The name Arib is also found in the Quranic reference to the prophet Abraham, who was known for his high moral character. This name is also associated with the Arabic word 'arib' meaning a stranger or a foreigner. In modern times, the name Arib has been adopted by many Muslim cultures around the world.
